FN-KHB2NUU-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 95
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Joe Lovvorn
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 01/07/2026
House Bill 95 as introduced would increase election expenses of the judges of probate by an
estimated minimum of $35,000 per day, cumulatively, to conduct post-election audits in the
county as required by this bill. This bill would increase the obligation of the state, presumably
the State General Fund, by a corresponding amount by requiring expenses incurred by a county
as a result of this audit to be fully reimbursed by the comptroller.
This bill would also increase the administrative obligations of the Secretary of State to post the
audit results to the Secretary's website, report the findings to the Governor and Legislature, and
adopt administrative rules to implement the provisions of this bill.
Page 1
